reproducibility: Execute python3 check_heterogeneous_proxy.py (standard library, exact rational arithmetic); read the full proof in RESULT.md.
scientific_integrity: Exact formulas were checked by independent enumeration; the infinite-sequence statements are proved analytically by a uniform local moderate-deviation argument. A priori pivotality is defined using forced direct YES/NO counterfactuals.
scientific_limitations: Independent unbiased ballots, one permanently direct root, unit weights and a binary majority quota are assumed. Arbitrary heterogeneous individual delegation propensities are a model extension. Neither correlated delegation nor multi-proxy networks are covered. Priority beyond the inspected literature is not independently certified.
title: Universal two-scale power concentration under heterogeneous proxy delegation
